boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten admission-free museum, wellness, and recreation hangs at CSUSB, with student eligibility and reservations noted where required.

cards.entity_name: Robert and Frances Fullerton Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse RAFFMA’s Galleries
cards.subtitle: Free art viewing for every visitor
cards.notes: Check the installation notice before walking over, then explore the open galleries together; the Egyptian gallery requires an emailed appointment.
cards.short_summary: Share an admission-free gallery afternoon spanning rotating art and ancient Egyptian objects.
cards.evidence_claim: RAFFMA states that admission is free for all visitors; its Egyptian gallery requires an appointment, and current gallery closures are posted online.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all visitors. Check current gallery status; email raffma@csusb.edu for an Egyptian gallery appointment.

cards.title: Tour the Student-Curated Displays
cards.subtitle: A free public museum hang in SB-306
cards.notes: Meet in the Social and Behavioral Sciences building, ride to the third floor, and compare notes on the current student-curated exhibits.
cards.short_summary: Explore changing displays shaped by CSUSB students and anthropological research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anthropology Museum says it is free and open to the public, requires no reservation for ordinary visits, and is located in SB-306.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public Monday through Friday, excluding university holidays; no reservation is necessary for ordinary visits.

cards.title: Take a Hammock Reset
cards.subtitle: A quiet no-charge break in SMSU South
cards.notes: Bring your Coyote ID, check in at The Retreat’s front desk, and claim a hammock for a shared screen-free pause between classes.
cards.short_summary: Turn a class break into a calm, purchase-free hammock session with friends nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies hammocks as a relaxation option at The Retreat and states that all current students, faculty, and staff may use The Retreat free of charge.
cards.source_title: Student Recreation & Wellness Center | Join the Pack | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current CSUSB students, faculty, and staff. Register and check in with a Coyote ID or the Recreation and Wellness app.

cards.title: Book Back-to-Back Massage Chairs
cards.subtitle: Free reserved relaxation for CSUSB members
cards.notes: Reserve chairs through the linked portal, arrive together at least ten minutes early, and keep your student ID ready for front-desk check-in.
cards.short_summary: Coordinate a no-cost recovery break using The Retreat’s reservable massage chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Retreat FAQ says all services are free, explains how members reserve massage chairs, and limits free access to current CSUSB students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Current CSUSB students, faculty, and staff only. Reserve online, check in with ID, and arrive on time to avoid cancellation.

cards.title: Reserve a Dog-Bed Rest Break
cards.subtitle: An unusual free recharge spot in SMSU South
cards.notes: Use the reservation portal, check in with your Coyote ID, and meet a friend nearby for a quiet rest without buying food or drinks.
cards.short_summary: Try The Retreat’s reservable dog beds for a playful but genuinely restful campus pause.
cards.evidence_claim: The Retreat FAQ provides reservations for dog beds and states that all Retreat services are free for current CSUSB students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Current CSUSB students, faculty, and staff only. A reservation and front-desk check-in with ID are required.

cards.title: Try a Climbing-Wall Session
cards.subtitle: Included recreation for enrolled CSUSB students
cards.notes: Bring valid student identification, review the posted climbing schedule, and start together on the bouldering area or 34-foot wall.
cards.short_summary: Add movement and conversation to a free-with-membership climbing meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies a 34-foot climbing and bouldering wall inside the Student Recreation and Wellness Center and says the facility is free for CSUSB students.
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled CSUSB students with valid identification; no additional SRWC membership fee is required. Check current climbing hours.

cards.title: Meet for a Campus Swim
cards.subtitle: Pool access included for enrolled students
cards.notes: Check the seasonal aquatics schedule, pack swim gear and student ID, and choose an open-swim window that works for the whole group.
cards.short_summary: Cool down together during a scheduled student pool session without an added admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB lists an aquatics facility as part of the Student Recreation and Wellness Center, which is free for CSUSB students; current aquatics hours are published online.
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled CSUSB students with included SRWC membership. Use only during posted aquatics hours and observe facility rules.

cards.title: Organize a Casual Shootaround
cards.subtitle: No-additional-fee court time for students
cards.notes: Meet inside the recreation center with valid student IDs, bring a ball if available, and confirm the court is open before starting a game.
cards.short_summary: Gather classmates for an informal basketball session on the SRWC indoor court.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists an indoor court among SRWC facilities and states that the center is free for CSUSB students.
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled CSUSB students may enter with valid identification and no additional membership fee; court availability may vary by programming.

cards.title: Start a Sand Volleyball Rally
cards.subtitle: Outdoor recreation included for students
cards.notes: Gather enough classmates for a rally, check court availability at the recreation center, and bring water and sun protection for outdoor play.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus sand courts for a low-pressure volleyball meetup between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB lists sand volleyball courts among Student Recreation and Wellness Center amenities and says the center is free for CSUSB students.
cards.source_title: Student Recreation & Wellness Center | Join the Pack | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled CSUSB students with included recreation membership. Confirm outdoor-court availability and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Trade Groundstrokes Outside
cards.subtitle: Student tennis without an added court fee
cards.notes: Coordinate rackets and balls before meeting, carry valid student IDs, and verify that recreation programming has not reserved the courts.
cards.short_summary: Pair up for a relaxed tennis rally on the recreation center’s outdoor courts.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies outdoor tennis courts as student recreation amenities and states that the Student Recreation and Wellness Center is free for CSUSB students.
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled CSUSB students have access without an additional membership fee. Equipment is not promised; confirm court availability before play.

warnings: Seven activities are restricted to currently enrolled CSUSB students or other eligible campus members; free access is not general-public access.
Campus parking may require payment, but every listed activity itself requires no admission charge or purchase.
RAFFMA may close galleries temporarily for installation, so visitors should check its official page before going.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because exact card-level locations were not independently verified from direct map records.
